name: minimal-page-cards
goal: Page cards show only their title and revision-bound screenshot

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The page catalog currently shows descriptions, counts, verdicts and an open icon. The requested card contains only its title and revision-bound screenshot. See minimal-page-cards feature spec.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing entity-preview-actions and catalog-previews cases only checked small open icons. Strengthened the same viewport cases to assert exact visible card text, one keyboard link and its screenshot; retained historical/missing/foreign evidence coverage. No record is attached to the reported current commit.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Commit 0d44843e; recorded regression e9cfa0dc3cfc7fb7dea022bce46e36a78e0b5126162a011b30059b0a03803432. The unchanged renderer fails the exact visible-card-content assertion in Reports and shared local/hosted viewport cases; before screenshots inspected.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 64ee5cbb makes each page title and screenshot one existing navigation link in Reports and the shared local/hosted renderer. Descriptions, counts, status marks and extra actions are removed for pages; screenshot provenance remains available on hover.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged tests at 64ee5cbb pass all three Reports widths and six shared local/hosted widths. Record ba592bacb18431709f2fab02c62de14a8a086c89c84f27a40364188f6f29c3b6 pairs with red e9cfa0dc at 0d44843e. After screenshots captured.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
